verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁיר־ חֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַבַּ֣יִת לְדָוִֽד׃ אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹא־ אֹיְבַ֣י שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr šîr- ḥă·nuk·kaṯ hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·rō·w·mim·ḵā Yah·weh kî ḏil·lî·ṯā·nî wə·lō- ’ō·yə·ḇay śim·maḥ·tā lî
verses.literal: A Psalm A song for the dedication of the temple Of David I will exalt You O LORD for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me
O LORD my God {I cried} to You for help and You healed me

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֑י הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־ שְׁא֣וֹל חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מִיּוֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nap̄·šî he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā min- šə·’ō·wl ḥî·yî·ṯa·nî mī·yō·rə·ḏē ḇō·wr
verses.literal: O LORD You pulled me up from Sheol You spared me from descending into the Pit

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ לְזֵ֣כֶר
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh ḥă·sî·ḏāw wə·hō·w·ḏū qā·ḏə·šōw lə·zê·ḵer
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD O you His saints and praise His holy name

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְּאַפּוֹ֮ רֶ֨גַע׀ בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ חַיִּ֪ים בֶּ֗כִי יָלִ֥ין בָּ֭עֶרֶב רִנָּֽה׃ וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר
verses.transliteration: kî bə·’ap·pōw re·ḡa‘ bir·ṣō·w·nōw ḥay·yîm be·ḵî yā·lîn bā·‘e·reḇ rin·nāh wə·lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: For His anger is fleeting but His favor lasts a lifetime Weeping may stay the night but joy [comes] in the morning

verses.original: בְשַׁלְוִ֑י וַ֭אֲנִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בַּל־ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ אֶמּ֥וֹט
verses.literal: In prosperity I said I will never . . . be shaken

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֪דְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִ֫י עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗יךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bir·ṣō·wn·ḵā he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tāh lə·har·rî ‘ōz his·tar·tā p̄ā·ne·ḵā hā·yî·ṯî niḇ·hāl
verses.literal: O LORD You favored me You made my mountain {stand} strong When You hid Your face I was dismayed

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וְאֶל־ אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י
verses.literal: To You O LORD I called and I begged my Lord {for mercy}

verses.original: מַה־ בֶּ֥צַע בְּדָמִי֮ בְּרִדְתִּ֪י אֶ֫ל־ שָׁ֥חַת עָפָ֑ר הֲיוֹדְךָ֥ הֲיַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- be·ṣa‘ bə·ḏā·mî bə·riḏ·tî ’el- šā·ḥaṯ ‘ā·p̄ār hă·yō·wḏ·ḵā hă·yag·gîḏ ’ă·mit·te·ḵā
verses.literal: What gain [is there] in my bloodshed in my descent to the Pit Will the dust praise You Will it proclaim Your faithfulness

verses.original: שְׁמַע־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחָנֵּ֑נִי יְ֝הוָה הֱ‍ֽיֵה־ עֹזֵ֥ר לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘- Yah·weh wə·ḥān·nê·nî haš·šēm hĕyêh- ‘ō·zêr lî
verses.literal: Hear me O LORD and have mercy O LORD be my helper

verses.original: הָפַ֣כְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי֮ לְמָח֪וֹל לִ֥י פִּתַּ֥חְתָּ שַׂקִּ֑י וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵ֥נִי שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄aḵ·tā mis·pə·ḏî lə·mā·ḥō·wl lî pit·taḥ·tā śaq·qî wat·tə·’az·zə·rê·nî śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: You turned my mourning into dancing You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן׀ יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אוֹדֶֽךָּ׃ לְעוֹלָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yə·zam·mer·ḵā ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·lō yid·dōm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay ’ō·w·ḏe·kā lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent O LORD my God I will give thanks forever
